title: Thank-you letters
description: Write one shared letter, approve it once, and send it to the people you appreciate. Each guest receives their own personalized greeting.
createStepTitle: Choose recipients and create a template
createStepDescription: Generate 1 or 3 options in one AI request. AI receives aggregate group, RSVP, and public-wish information only; it never receives guest names or private wishes.
includeGiftAmount: Include confirmed gift amounts in the new draft. Only guests with confirmed gifts receive this line; it is omitted for everyone else.
reviewStepTitle: Choose, preview, and approve a shared template
reviewStepDescription: Reuse a template across multiple sends. Edit and approve it once; each guest still has a separate delivery status.
emptyTemplates: Choose your recipients, then create one letter. You can reuse it for future sends.
giftLinePaidOnly: the gift line appears only for confirmed transactions
giftPlaceholderHint: This placeholder is replaced with a thank-you line for a confirmed gift, or removed:
selectTemplateHint: Select a template to preview and review it.
sendStepDescription: One approved letter is personalized and sent individually to each guest. You only need to send once.
deliveryHint: Each guest and channel has its own status. Guests can reopen their message using its personal link after it is delivered.

errors.aiUnavailable: AI isn't configured; a fallback template will be used if the provider is unavailable.
errors.rateLimited: You've reached the short-term generation limit. Wait a little and try again.
errors.conflict: This template changed on another device. Reload it before continuing.
errors.contactRequired: Some guests don't have contact details for the selected channel.
errors.generic: Couldn't complete the action. Check the information and try again.
errors.channelUnavailable: This delivery channel is not configured. Choose another channel or check configuration.

composeDescription: Let AI draft one shared letter. Make it your own before approving.
personalizationHint: Each guest name is filled in using
saveBeforeReview: Save your edits before previewing and approving.
previewBeforeApprove: Preview the letter for one guest before approving.
approveOnce: Approve once for all selected recipients.
approvedReusable: Approved and ready to reuse for your recipients.
recipientsTitle: Who would you like to thank?
recipientsDescription: Select your entire guest list or choose the people for this send.
approveBeforeSend: Preview and approve your letter before sending.
missingContacts: {{count}} selected guests lack contact details for this channel. Add their details or deselect them.
confirmSend: Send the approved thank-you letter to {{count}} guests via {{channels}}?
uncertainSend: The previous request has not been confirmed. Continue the same send below to avoid duplicate messages.
discardEdits: You have unsaved edits. Discard them to continue?
removeMissingContacts: Deselect {{count}} guests with missing contact details
